decisive_spans.text: A few pustules were also noted in the perioral area

response.rationale: The presence of pustules in the perioral area, in addition to the periorbital areas, strongly supports perioral dermatitis. While Demodex folliculitis is a strong contender given the pustules and periorbital involvement, the explicit mention of perioral pustules makes perioral dermatitis a more direct fit.
